name: The Deathstalkers' Report
summary: Near the northern wilds, the Deathstalkers have found Scourge forces where the Forsaken did not expect them. You carry their report from the wounded scouts to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher, bringing word that Silverpine Forest holds a greater threat than command believed.

sections.title: Frontline Intelligence
sections.body:
The Deathstalkers scout ahead for the Dark Lady, slipping into wild country before the main forces. Near the border of Tirisfal and Silverpine, one patrol met fierce resistance while tracking enemy movements.

Deathstalker Quinn barely survived his wounds, while Erland fought his way to safety. Their patrol still gathered intelligence the Forsaken need to hold Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: The Scourge Factor
sections.body:
High Executor Hadrec reads the sealed report and learns that the Scourge hold a stronger presence in Silverpine than Undercity strategists expected. Their forces are more active and aggressive than command believed.

The Forsaken had planned to secure abandoned human hamlets and drive off rogue beasts. Now the Sepulcher's command must prepare for organized Scourge opposition as it fights to claim the region.

faq.answer: Deathstalker Rane Yorick wrote the field report for her wounded scouting cell. It records the threats they saw, including unexpected Scourge activity in northern Silverpine Forest, and brings that intelligence to the regional commander at the Sepulcher.
High Executor Hadrec commands Forsaken operations in Silverpine Forest. From the Sepulcher, he coordinates scouts, defenses, and the campaign against the Scourge and hostile humans in the region.

faq.q: Why was the report's information a surprise to Hadrec?
faq.answer: The Forsaken leadership believed the Scourge in Silverpine was scattered and few in number beside the fighting in Tirisfal Glades and the Plaguelands. The Deathstalkers' losses and discoveries show that the Lich King's minions remain entrenched and dangerous this far south.

The Deathstalkers are an elite Forsaken order of assassins, spies, and forward scouts under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's command. They range through contested lands to find threats before the regular army advances.
The Sepulcher lies in central Silverpine Forest, just west of the main north-south road. It is a crypt and base camp for Forsaken forces across the province.

faq.q: What happens after Hadrec reads the report?
faq.answer: After reading the report, Hadrec sends you to consult specialists at the Sepulcher, beginning with Apothecary Renferrel. They will help develop ways to counter the threats in Silverpine.

angles.text: As an Undead, you bring intelligence that supports the Undercity's expansion. It proves your reliability to High Executor Hadrec and the Deathstalker network.
As a Rogue, you carry vital dispatches for the Forsaken's leading spies. Your work aligns you with the Dark Lady's shadow operatives.
As a member of the Horde, you help the Forsaken secure Silverpine against the Scourge. Their hold there strengthens the Horde's foothold across northern Lordaeron.
